description: This file defines a template class PointerSet for managing a set of non-owning, non-null pointers with efficient lookup, insertion, and removal, using a hash table implementation. It includes the PointerSetNode struct for internal node management and provides methods for set operations and iteration.

classes.name: PointerSetNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the PointerSet hash table, storing a pointer and providing methods to check if it is null, a tombstone, or valid, and to compute hash values.

classes.name: PointerSet
classes.description: A template class implementing a set of non-owning, non-null pointers using a hash table for fast operations. Supports copying, moving, range insertion, set intersection, and iteration.

methods.name: PointerSet(const PointerSet& other)
methods.description: Copy constructor that initializes the set by inserting elements from another set.

methods.name: template <typename InputIter> PointerSet(InputIter first, InputIter last)
methods.description: Range constructor to initialize the set with elements from an iterator range.

methods.name: bool add(T* ptr)
methods.description: Adds a pointer to the set; returns true if added, false if already present.

methods.name: bool contains(T* ptr) const
methods.description: Checks if a pointer is in the set.

methods.name: bool erase(T* ptr)
methods.description: Removes a pointer from the set; returns true if removed.

methods.name: void insert(T* ptr)
methods.description: Inserts a pointer into the set.

methods.name: template <typename InputIter> void insert(InputIter first, InputIter last)
void insert(const PointerSet& other)
methods.description: Inserts all elements from another PointerSet.

methods.name: PointerSet intersection_with(const PointerSet& other) const
methods.description: Returns a new set that is the intersection with another set.

methods.name: struct const_iterator
methods.description: Const iterator for traversing the set.

methods.name: begin()
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: end()
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end.

methods.name: std::vector<T*> ToVector() const
methods.description: Converts the set to a vector of pointers.
